2/S0.subgoal: Describe the various application domains and market forecasts for virtual reality technology.

2/S1.subgoal: Introduce the three categories of VR systems and describe the non-immersive category.

2/S2.subgoal: Explain the characteristics and common uses of semi-immersive VR systems.

2/S3.subgoal: Explain the characteristics and requirements of fully immersive VR systems.

2/S4.subgoal: Compare the three categories of VR systems and summarize the main points of the lecture.
